programs.title: Elementary
programs.desc: While Kitty tries to find a runaway teen, Sherlock and Joan work a case in which the murder of a brilliant bioengineer looks to be at the hands of a drug cartel. Also, Joan makes a major life decision but worries it will impact Sherlock negatively, not knowing that Sherlock has big news of his own.

programs.title: ER
programs.desc: Pratt, facing gunfire, loses control of his vehicle, trapping himself and his passengers under water; Dr. Weaver stops a police officer from performing a body search on a young woman; Dr. Carter and Kem deal with their child's remains.

programs.title: QI
programs.desc: Stephen Fry asks questions on the subject of Indecision with guests Phill Jupitus, Rich Hall, Jimmy Carr and the ever-present Alan Davies.

programs.title: Mythbusters
programs.desc: Adam and Jamie hit the console, tablet and arcade and take first person aim at some of the troubling tropes and scientific challenges common to the format.
